ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a Li3Ga2 alloy anode combining an ultralow deposition potential (0.007 V) with fast Li diffusivity (2.0×10–8 cm2 s–1) via moderate Li/Ga antisite mixing. This enables a 24 mA cm–2 critical current density, 96.5% initial Coulombic efficiency, 2000-cycle life, and stable pouch cells—redefining alloy anode design by synergistically optimizing potential and atomic diffusivity.
